scouting_brief.prose: Klint Kubiak named him the starter on Sept. 2 over No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza ("Kirk's had a really good offseason, very good camp and he's earned it"), and three weeks of winning has made the job his: 3-0, 67.4 percent, 661 yards, nine touchdowns against three picks, and the first Raiders quarterback ever to throw three touchdown passes in each of the team's first three games. Kubiak calls the plays himself and the quick-rhythm passing game runs through Brock Bowers and Tre Tucker, which is why the volume is modest (248 yards in the Week 3 comeback at New Orleans) while the scoring is not. The route back to Mendoza runs through losses, not practice reps, so the thing to watch each week is the record. At 38 and unbeaten he is the rare veteran bridge whose bridge has not come up yet.
scouting_brief.rationale: Coach-named starter on Sept. 2 and 3-0 with nine touchdowns in three games; the No. 1 pick behind him is a real but conditional threat that needs losing first.
